fields.System.Title: CNT-4 — Accuracy reporting
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Show where inaccuracy comes from, so effort goes into fixing causes instead of repeatedly
correcting the same symptom.

Scope

In. Variance rates by zone, product class, and operator; trends over time.

Out. Financial reporting on stock value. Labour performance management.

Design notes

These are aggregates over history, so they belong in a read model, refreshed daily. A live
query over every count result will get slower every month.

Each cut answers a different question.

| Cut | Points at |
|---|---|
| By zone | A layout, labelling, or congestion problem in one area |
| By product class | A master data problem — case quantity, UoM, barcode |
| By operator | A training need, or a shortcut being taken |
| Over time | Whether anything you did actually helped |

Handle the operator cut carefully. It is a training signal, not a disciplinary tool. Used
as the latter, operators stop reporting shorts honestly and the data becomes worthless — which
costs more than the behaviour it was meant to correct.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Live aggregate query degrading over time | [doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
| Operator metrics driving dishonest reporting | [doc 01 §3](../../../docs/01-product-overview.md) |
